svg.title: Seventeen findings, laned by who found them
svg.desc: Eighteen tiles for seventeen findings, laned by who found them: eight from this project's own machinery, five from an outside audit, one from an anomaly, two from readers not looking for defects, and two from this project auditing itself later. Findings 9 to 15 came from outside the repository.
